name: Fallen Empire
notes: Main Menu PDF (cocktails + raw bar, single-column with dot leaders) parsed cleanly via pdftotext -layout. The separate Wine Menu PDF is two-column and pdftotext scrambled name/price pairing across columns (e.g. vintage years concatenating directly into unrelated prices with no separator) - excluded entirely rather than guessing pairings; this is a partial capture, food/cocktail side only. 'caviar service' printed as a single line with two prices (1oz/2oz) and is filed as two dishes at its own printed prices, not divided or computed. One dish name ('Seafood Tower (for the table)') was garbled by page-decoration text overlapping the PDF extraction ('llen pl fa at'); renamed for clarity based on its description line, price kept exactly as printed ($185).
